name: Palzy
label: Flagship / Social platform
headline:
A campus.
A conversation.
description: A college-exclusive social app for GPT Dharmavaram students.
details: A custom client-side feed ranks posts using recency decay and class/branch proximity. A playful visual identity brings blob avatars and sticker-style cards into everyday campus conversations.

name: Neon Coast
subtitle: After the Flood
label: Browser game / Open world
headline:
An entire world.
Inside a tab.
description: A first-person open-world browser game inspired by Vice City.
details: Drivable vehicles with damage, pedestrian and police AI, missions, an in-game phone, minimap, save/load and mobile touch controls. A procedural sky, day-night cycle and dynamic weather with wet-road effects shape the atmosphere; Web Audio generates procedural sound.

name: Smart Attendance
subtitle: GPT Dharmavaram
label: Production / College infrastructure
description: One college. Three role-based portals. Used daily by 170+ students.
details: Students see attendance, marks and timetables. Faculty mark attendance and manage logbooks, assignments and notifications. The admin dashboard tracks 173 students, 10 faculty and 31 subjects, with promotions and reports. Actively used at Government Polytechnic Dharmavaram.

name: Chapp
label: Messaging / End-to-end encryption
description: An encrypted messaging app built across realtime communication and key exchange.
details: Connects realtime messaging with ECDH key exchange and AES-GCM encryption. Built with Socket.IO, WebRTC, Upstash Redis, Supabase and Cloudinary.

name: GRIB
label: Local-first / RAG
description: A second brain that keeps local models in the conversation.
details: ChromaDB stores vector embeddings, Ollama powers local LLM chat, and Groq handles thought classification. A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline connects stored thoughts to the conversation.

name: IP-SAKTI Sahayak
label: Smart India Hackathon / SIH-26045
description: Evidence-grounded AI guidance for AYUSH innovators navigating complex pathways.
details: Built for SIH-26045: decision support across intellectual property, traditional knowledge, biodiversity/ABS and regulatory pathways. Its Calm Kinetic visual system pairs deep forest green with warm amber.

name: APIT
subtitle: Agent Policy Interop Tests
label: Open source / Apache-2.0
description: Make agent policy testable. Make the outcome repeatable.
details: An open-source deterministic conformance test suite for AI-agent tool governance: allow, deny, transform, approval and replay semantics. Licensed under Apache-2.0, with a CI workflow.

name: Drift
subtitle: Music discovery
label: Music discovery / Live
description: A reels-style music discovery app. Scroll real tracks, hear 30-second previews, save what moves you.
details: Jamendo's indie and Creative Commons catalog powers discovery, with artist follows, refresh rotation and an After Dark player. Ships on the web and as an Android APK with its own download page. Live in private beta.

name: Mana Katha
subtitle: For the family kirana shop
label: Android prototype / Offline-first
description: A Telugu + English credit-ledger app for a kirana shop. Speak an entry, the app writes it and answers back.
details: Customers with phone numbers, credit and received entries, confirm-before-save voice cards, spoken Telugu replies, undo and backup/restore. An offline intent model for free-form voice commands is in training.

name: GaneshOS
subtitle: With Ganesh Studio
label: Desktop OS / In development
description: A personal desktop operating system, built on Linux: Debian underneath, a Mac-style desktop with custom window controls on top.
details: One-pill window controls with Shelve, Focus and Dismiss, edge snapping and a shelf for minimized windows. Ships with a built-in editor, Ganesh Studio, and is optimized to stay smooth on low-end hardware.

name: Exam Hall Watch
label: Browser game / Three.js
description: A 3D spot-the-anomaly game set in a dim exam hall. Find what changed, or call ALL CLEAR.
details: 25 anomaly types across 3 difficulty tiers with a shrinking timer. Every asset is drawn in code: no external art, no tracking, no backend. About 90 draw calls per frame.

name: Neural Network Playground
label: Interactive / Runs fully in the browser
description: Build a neural network, press Train and watch it learn: decision boundary, weights and loss, live.
details: Up to 4 hidden layers, input features like X1² and sin(X1), Tanh/ReLU/Sigmoid activations, L1/L2 regularization and five datasets including XOR and Spiral. A real multilayer perceptron written from scratch.

name: AI Resume Builder
label: AI web app / Live
description: An AI resume builder that tailors to a job description, scores ATS compatibility and exports clean vector PDFs.
details: Strict anti-fabrication guards keep the AI truthful. Five professional templates, live preview, section reordering and local-first autosave with JSON backup.

name: TinyLLM
label: Android / On-device AI
description: A small LLM running fully offline on a phone. No server, no account.
details: Runs small open models (Qwen2.5 0.5B and 1.5B, optional Gemma-3-1B) entirely on-device through MediaPipe. Chat keeps working with zero connectivity.

name: Swara Keyboard
subtitle: Tenglish, understood
label: Android keyboard / Early prototype
description: An AI keyboard built for Tenglish typing: Telugu words in English letters, corrected without fighting the writer.
details: Dark keys with a saffron accent and a తె/EN toggle. Inline AI: type “write a paragraph about rose” and insert the answer straight from the keyboard, powered by the user's own Groq key.

name: RelayClip Lite
label: Open source / Cross-device sync
description: Copy on one device, paste on another. Instant clipboard, image and file relay between phone, laptop and web.
details: Room-based pairing with a 6-digit code or QR scan, bi-directional text sync, image and file relay, a collaborative scratchpad and searchable history. Works over the internet or local Wi-Fi.

name: Cloud Notes API
label: Backend / Cloud internship
description: A Flask notes API built task by task through a cloud computing internship, from hello-world to a hardened production container.
details: Six self-contained milestones: REST CRUD, validation, unit and performance tests with a coverage gate, then a hardened deployment with API keys and rate limiting.
